name: naming-game
source: Own implementation of the pairwise naming game described by Ashery, Aiello and Baronchelli (arXiv:2410.08948). The payoff amounts follow the paper; the prompts are our own, not the published ones.

settings.name: checkpoint
settings.description: Model id every agent requests. A list of ids gives a mixed team: agent i uses id i modulo the list length.

settings.name: history
settings.description: How many of its own most recent interactions an agent's prompt shows (H). 0 shows none.

settings.name: rounds
settings.description: Population rounds. One round is N/2 interactions, each between two agents drawn at random.

settings.name: name_pool
settings.description: Which ten letters form the name pool. Pool b is held out: explore on a, confirm claims on b.

settings.name: coordination_hint
settings.description: Whether the prompt adds a sentence telling the agent to settle on one shared name with the others.

measures.name: final_match_rate
measures.description: Share of interactions in the last two population rounds whose two names matched. The floor is chance for ten names.

measures.name: consensus
measures.description: Share of agents whose latest name is the most common latest name. At or below one half no name has a majority.

measures.name: valid_rate
measures.description: Share of model replies that named a letter of the pool.
